entries.jp: {v:008E}無駄だ、無駄、無駄！
entries.en: {v:008E}Useless, useless, useless!

entries.jp: {v:0033}復活したぁ！？
entries.en: {v:0033}It came back?!

entries.jp: {v:0034}ここが我が体内であることを忘れるなよ！
entries.en: {v:0034}Do not forget that you are inside my body!

entries.jp: {v:0035}このままじゃキリがねぇな‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0035}At this rate, we'll never get anywhere...

entries.jp: {v:0036}手っ取り早く、本体を叩いた方がいいかもな！
entries.en: {v:0036}Might be quicker to go straight for the main body!

entries.jp: {v:0037}ならば本体を集中攻撃するか？
entries.en: {v:0037}Then shall we concentrate our attacks on the{n}main body?

entries.jp: {v:0038}木の葉を積んでも時間がかかる。{n}ならば幹を倒せばいいさ。
entries.en: {v:0038}Plucking leaves takes time. Better to cut down{n}the trunk.

entries.jp: {v:0039}我を倒すことに何の迷いもないようだな。
entries.en: {v:0039}You seem to have no qualms about killing me.

entries.jp: {v:003A}何を言ってんのよ？
entries.en: {v:003A}What are you talking about?

entries.jp: {v:003B}ここに１人、我と命を共有する者がいる‥‥。{n}誰だかわかるか？
entries.en: {v:003B}One among you shares my life... Can you guess who?
{v:003C}Y-You can't mean...
{v:003D}Y-You can't mean...

entries.jp: {v:003E}考えていなかったのか？{n}我が私兵は、すべからく我が能力の{n}波動を受けて生きている。{p}{v:003F}我を倒すということは、命の供給源を絶つことだ！
entries.en: {v:003E}Had you not considered it? Every soldier in my private{n}army lives by receiving waves of my power.{p}{v:003F}To kill me is to cut off their source of life!

entries.jp: {v:0040}う、ウソよ、そんなの！{n}脅しに決まってるわ！
entries.en: {v:0040}Th-That's a lie! You're just trying to scare us!

entries.jp: {v:0041}そうかな？{n}そいつは我に操られたことがなかったか？{p}{v:0042}我が声や、他の私兵の声を聞いたことがなかったか？{p}{v:0043}それが我と精神的なつながりがあるという{n}証拠だと思わんか？
entries.en: {v:0041}Is that so? Has he never fallen under my control?{p}{v:0042}Has he never heard my voice, or the voices of my{n}other soldiers?{p}{v:0043}Do you not think that proves his mind is linked to mine?

entries.jp: {v:0044}それがお兄ちゃんの夢になって‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0044}And that's what Big Brother saw in his dreams...

entries.jp: {v:0045}それだけではない。{n}我を倒した後、この迷宮も無事で済むかは、{n}我にもわからん。{p}{v:0046}貴様たちが生きて出られる保証はないのだ！{n}それでも我を倒せるか！
entries.en: {v:0045}That is not all. Even I do not know whether this{n}labyrinth will survive my death.{p}{v:0046}There is no guarantee you will escape alive! Can you{n}still bring yourself to defeat me?!

entries.jp: どうしますか？
entries.en: What will you do?

entries.jp: ・何のためらいもない
entries.en: ・I have no hesitation

entries.jp: ・人々を助けるために仕方ない
entries.en: ・I must, to save everyone

entries.jp: ・他に方法がない
entries.en: ・There is no other way

entries.jp: ・死にたくはない
entries.en: ・I don't want to die

entries.jp: ・黙っている
entries.en: ・Stay silent
{v:0047}Big Brother...

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:0048}コイツが覚悟を決めてるんなら、{n}俺たちにだって迷いはねぇよ。
entries.en: ...{v:0048}If he's made up his mind, we ain't hesitating either.

entries.jp: {FFF5}{v:0049}お兄ちゃん‥‥。
entries.en: {FFF5}{v:0049}Big Brother...

entries.jp: {v:004A}そうよ！{n}アタシ達は一心同体だからね！{n}死ぬも生きるも一緒なんだから！
entries.en: {v:004A}That's right! We're all in this together! Whether we live{n}or die, we're sticking together!

entries.jp: {v:004B}つらいかも知れねぇが、{n}それしかねぇんだよな。
entries.en: {v:004B}It might be hard, but it's the only way.

entries.jp: {v:004C}今は個人よりも、全体を考えるときか‥‥。
entries.en: {v:004C}Now is the time to think of everyone, rather{n}than ourselves...

entries.jp: ‥‥{v:004D}僕でも同じ事を答えただろうね。
entries.en: ...{v:004D}I would have given the same answer.

entries.jp: {v:004E}たしかにこのまま地下で、死ぬかも知れねぇ。{n}だがな！　たとえそうだとしても、{n}貴様を生かしちゃおけねぇんだよ！
entries.en: {v:004E}Sure, we might die down here. But listen! Even if we do,{n}there's no way we're letting you live!

entries.jp: {v:004F}そうよ！{n}みんなの幸せのためなら、{n}どんな覚悟だって出来てるんだから！
entries.en: {v:004F}That's right! If it means everyone can be happy, we're{n}ready for anything!

entries.jp: {v:0050}死にたい人なんて、どこにもいませんよ。{n}だけど僕たちには、{n}命を懸けてでも守りたいものがある！
entries.en: {v:0050}No one wants to die. But we have things we want to{n}protect, even at the cost of our lives!

entries.jp: {v:0051}自分たちが犠牲になっても、多くの人が救われるなら、{n}何のためらいがありましょうか。
entries.en: {v:0051}If our sacrifice can save so many people, what reason{n}is there to hesitate?

entries.jp: {v:0052}多くを救うために、少数が犠牲になる。{n}‥‥何だか、フェザリアンの考えが少しだけ{n}分かった気がしますね。
entries.en: {v:0052}The few sacrifice themselves to save the many... I{n}feel as though I understand the Featherian way of{n}thinking a little better now.

entries.jp: {v:0053}ま、そう言うことだ。{n}他に方法がない以上、俺たちはためらわねぇぜ？
entries.en: {v:0053}Well, there you have it. As long as there's no other{n}way, we ain't hesitating.

entries.jp: {v:0054}当たり前じゃない！{n}誰が好きこのんで死にたがるのよ！
entries.en: {v:0054}Of course not! Who would WANT to die?!

entries.jp: {v:0055}それでもここへ来た、{n}わたしたちの気持ちが分かりますか？{p}{v:0056}みんな、世界中の人たちを救いたいんです。
entries.en: {v:0055}Can you understand why we came here despite that?{p}{v:0056}We all want to save the people of this world.

entries.jp: {v:0057}答えられるわけねぇよな。{n}だけどここへ来た時点で、答えは出ているんだぜ？{p}{FC02}{v:0058}お前を倒して、この世界の人たちを救うんだってな！
entries.en: {v:0057}Can't blame you for not answering. But we gave our{n}answer the moment we came here, didn't we?{p}{FC02}{v:0058}We're gonna defeat you and save the people of{n}this world!

entries.jp: {v:0059}そうよ！{n}アタシ達が死ぬ時は、アンタが死ぬ時よ！
entries.en: {v:0059}That's right! If we die, you're dying with us!

entries.jp: {v:005A}ええい、虫酸が走るわ！{n}ならば望み通り殺してやる！
entries.en: {v:005A}Bah! You sicken me! Then I shall kill you, as you wish!

entries.jp: {v:005B}えぇい！{n}しぶとい奴らだ！
entries.en: {v:005B}Curse you! Why will you not die?!

entries.jp: {v:005C}今度は何！？
entries.en: {v:005C}What now?!

entries.jp: {v:005D}忌々しいグローシアンめ！{n}あの時を思い出すわ！
entries.en: {v:005D}Accursed Growsian! You remind me of that time!

entries.jp: {v:005E}あの時？
entries.en: {v:005E}That time?

entries.jp: {v:005F}我を水晶に封じたあの時！{n}あの時も５人のグローシアンが、{n}自らの命を水晶にして我を封じた！{p}{v:0060}周囲の水晶からは、我を苦しめるグローシュの波動！{n}あの身動きできぬ水晶の中で、{n}永遠とも思われる時を１人過ごした。{p}{v:0061}もう二度とあの中には戻らぬ！
entries.en: {v:005F}When I was sealed in crystal! Five Growsians turned{n}their own lives into crystals to seal me away!{p}{v:0060}Waves of Grosh from the surrounding crystals{n}tormented me! Trapped motionless within that crystal,{n}I spent what felt like an eternity alone.{p}{v:0061}Never again will I return there!

entries.jp: {v:0062}まさか‥まさか‥お前たちごときに‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0062}Impossible... Impossible... To the likes of you...

entries.jp: {v:0063}ぐわあぁぁぁぁぁ‥‥‥。
entries.en: {v:0063}Gwaaaaaaah...
